title: ThermaDucts
description: This mod adds Thermal Dynamics-style duct networks for transporting items, fluids, energy, and players, with servos, retrievers, filters, and relays.
body:
ThermaDucts brings back the Thermal Dynamics legacy duct system to modern Minecraft. Build pipe networks to transport items, fluids, energy, and even players.

Features:
- Energy Ducts (Fluxducts): 6 tiers from Leadstone to Cryo-Stabilized
- Fluid Ducts (Fluiducts): Basic, Hardened, Super-Laminar, and Signalum-Plated variants
- Item Ducts (Itemducts): Basic, Dense, Impulse, Vacuum, and Flux-Plated variants
- Transport Ducts (Viaducts): Send players between endpoints
- Structural Ducts & Lux Ducts
- Servos, Retrievers, and Filters with 5 tiers each
- Redstone Relays with 16 color channels
- 9 new alloys with standalone recipes (Lead, Tin, Silver, Invar, Electrum, Bronze, Signalum, Enderium, Lumium)

Requires NeoForge 26.1.2+ and CodeChicken Lib.
